<!-- What you want, as you'd type it to /create. The queue splits it into
     pieces (a mockup only where there is something to see, then builds),
     opens each as a child issue with its estimate in points of the week,
     and lists them here. Reply "approve" here to start them all, or on each
     child: "approve", "no" (to the backlog), or a note. An approved mockup
     closes; an approved build merges; this issue closes when no piece is
     left open. -->
